mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces inflationary pressure and delays monetary tightening, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0), or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
